SimpleABTesting.SimpleABTestingTagDescription: Adds a tag for a Simple A/B Testing experiment
SimpleABTesting.Title: SimpleABTesting
SimpleABTesting.ReportHelpText: Here you can see the reports for your experiments, and when the reports was last archived - reports needs to be archived to show up.
SimpleABTesting.GoalsReportHelpText: Goal conversions broken down by experiment, then variant, then goal. Expand an experiment to see its variants; expand a variant to see its goals.
